categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in the functional thin film materials industry, specifically manufacturing and selling smart card substrates. The main business segments include: (1) Smart card base materials (PETG, PVC, ABS, PC, bio-based, and recycled materials) used in financial cards, ID documents, and communication cards; (2) Coated series materials for high-end and customized cards; (3) Other functional films for applications in flooring, decoration, and automotive electronics. The company is a national-level specialized and sophisticated 'little giant' enterprise and the designated supplier of second-generation ID card materials in China.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced production technologies including calendering, coating, extrusion (single and multi-layer), and cast film processes. Core technologies include the development and production of PETG, PVC, ABS, PC, bio-based, and recycled smart card substrate materials. The company has obtained GRS (Global Recycling Standard) certification and UL2809 certification for recycled materials production. Production equipment is imported from Germany, Italy, and Japan, featuring automation and intelligence with real-time monitoring and automatic adjustment capabilities.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Primary customers include: (1) Listed companies such as Eastcompeace, Chutianlongtech, Hengsuo, Jinbangda, and Donggang; (2) Government certificate production units including the Ministry of Public Security Research Institute and second-generation ID card manufacturers; (3) International smart card manufacturers including G&D, Linxens, and IDEMIA. End markets include financial payment cards, mobile communication cards, government ID documents, social security cards, transportation cards, and emerging applications in new energy vehicles and environmental protection materials.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with headquarters in Xinyi, Jiangsu Province. It has established subsidiaries including Shanghai Yining Technology (Shanghai), Shanghai Huming Sheng Technology (Shanghai), and Jiangsu Huaxin High-new Materials (Xinyi). The company serves both domestic and international markets, with 2024 domestic revenue representing 73.68% and overseas revenue 26.32% of total sales. International markets include Southeast Asia, Africa, and other emerging markets.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates in the midstream of the supply chain as a materials manufacturer. It sources raw materials (polymers and chemicals) from suppliers and produces functional thin film materials that are sold to downstream smart card manufacturers and integrators who produce finished smart cards for end-users in financial, government, and communication sectors.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include: (1) Securing supply of second-generation ID and travel document materials; (2) Accelerating R&D and industrialization of low-carbon environmental materials (PETG, PC, bio-based, recycled materials); (3) Deepening industrial chain strategic cooperation and developing new materials and products; (4) Expanding into emerging markets and completing global business layout. R&D focuses on high-performance PVC films, low-fluorescence PC materials, high-adhesion PETG materials, laser-sensitive films for travel documents, and bio-based degradable materials.
categories.revenue_model: The company generates revenue primarily through product sales of smart card substrate materials. Revenue is recognized when goods are delivered to customers (domestic sales upon receipt confirmation, overseas sales upon customs clearance). The company operates on a made-to-order basis with customers, providing customized solutions. Secondary revenue comes from rental of investment properties and other business activities.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading enterprise in the smart card substrate industry with significant market share in the mid-to-high-end segment. It competes with other functional film manufacturers but maintains competitive advantages through long-term relationships with major customers, advanced technology, and product differentiation. The company's position is strengthened by its status as the designated supplier for second-generation ID cards and its recognition as a national-level specialized and sophisticated 'little giant' enterprise.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: 2024 revenue was 318.73 million yuan (down 2.54% from 327.05 million in 2023). Net profit attributable to parent company was 50.60 million yuan (up 23.46% from 40.98 million in 2023). Total assets reached 928.56 million yuan (up 20.78% from 768.81 million in 2023). The company shows stable profitability with improving margins despite slight revenue decline, driven by product mix optimization toward higher-margin environmental materials.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company differentiates through: (1) Comprehensive product portfolio including PETG, PVC, ABS, PC, bio-based, and recycled materials meeting diverse customer needs; (2) Advanced production technology and equipment from leading international suppliers ensuring high quality and stability; (3) Strong R&D capabilities with national-level postdoctoral research station and engineering research centers; (4) Long-term strategic partnerships with leading downstream customers enabling early access to market trends; (5) Environmental sustainability focus with GRS and UL2809 certifications for recycled materials; (6) 26+ years of industry experience and established reputation as the designated national supplier for ID card materials.
